verdict.rationale: Evidence shows Adyen supports building integrations for web, iOS, Android, React Native, and Flutter (implying platform SDKs) and provides an OpenAPI spec repo explicitly described as the 'single source of truth' usable 'to generate client libraries.' This confirms an official SDK/tooling foundation but the pack never lists concrete named SDKs (e.g., Node.js, Java, Python, .NET) or SDK-specific docs/reference pages, nor independent developer corroboration of SDK quality. missing for 10: explicit named SDK catalog/reference docs, independent/hands-on validation of SDK usage.
